definitions: A marine mollusc with a spiral, chambered shell, found mainly in the tropical Pacific and Indian Oceans.
Any of various cephalopods of the genus Nautilus, having a spiral shell with a pearly interior.
An early submarine, especially one designed by Robert Fulton.
examples: The nautilus propels itself by expelling water.
She admired the intricate shell of the nautilus.
Fulton's nautilus was a pioneering submersible.
